issue_request: FHIR-32017 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction asking to replace entry.search.mode = search with entry.search.mode = match in the Search page _count section because search is not a SearchEntryMode code.
initial_application: PR #1428 applied the issue before this reconciliation. Commit 29156a3f9f, matching source branch commit b1647bc02f, changed source/search.html from entry.search.mode = search to entry.search.mode = match, and merge commit 338bf6b986 brought the fix into the main history.
additional_context: The current source/search.html page is the normative Search (RESTful API) source page and its _count section still says entry.search.mode = match. The SearchEntryMode code system defines match, include, and outcome, with no search code. A 2023 Zulip thread about the same page noted the published R4 typo and recorded that it was already fixed in the R5 build; issue-key Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting WG record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch because the current source already implements the requested correction and remains consistent with the required SearchEntryMode binding.
